02 / FONCTIONNALITÉS
What KLASSCI does for you
Every feature was built by listening to the real needs of the schools we've supported since 2023.
Grade entry & report cards
Teachers enter grades directly from their phones. Averages, ranks, and comments are computed automatically. PDF report cards are generated in one click, branded with your school colours.
Real-time financial tracking
See each student's payment status instantly. Send automatic reminders, generate receipts, and export financial reports. Compatible with category-based fee systems.
Configure teaching hours for each programme/level combination. Track planned vs delivered hours with a clean admin dashboard.
Comprehensive dashboard for student attendance. Teachers run a digital roll-call or admin staff mark presences. Real-time rates, trends, and exportable reports.
Full LMD system
Manages units, course modules, credits, and semesters in line with UEMOA standards. Adapted report cards, automatic credit validation, and full student pathway tracking.
Unified administration of coordinators, teachers, secretaries, and accountants. Overview with role/status filters and fast search.
Track students with disabilities, learning accommodations, extra time, required assistants and official recognition with adapted permissions.
End-to-end workflow: from application to validation, with document and required-paperwork tracking.
Principal, secretary, teacher, accountant, coordinator — each one sees only what concerns them.
API & integrations
Connect KLASSCI to your LMS or existing system through our documented REST API.
